post.description:
One grounded chat turn over the search index.

Rewrites the turn with the transcript, searches via the engine as
the only tool, and synthesizes a cited answer. Fail-closed: a
missing/disabled model backend (or a model error) returns an empty
answer with a ``notice`` plus plain-search hits — never a 500.

get.description:
Prefix completions for `q` from index terms (static fallback).

Blank `q` returns `[]` with 200. Never 500s: helper failures
degrade to `[]`.

post.description:
Record one anonymous feedback event as an in-process count.

The tally key is ``(doc_id, action, reason)`` with ``""`` for absent
reasons, so reason-less posts keep their exact historic shape. The
module-level tally is the canonical response source; when the app
engine exposes ``record_feedback`` the ``(doc_id, action)`` event is
mirrored there too (best-effort, never failing the request) so
future ranking can consume the counts.

get.description:
Admin-only feedback overview (same gate as config mutations).

Aggregates the anonymous tallies: totals by action and reason plus
the noisiest documents. Gated because even anonymous aggregates
describe user behavior; reads stay open only when no admin token is
configured (local dev), exactly like the other admin reads.

Admin-only durable analytics counts (same gate as config mutations).

Reads the separate analytics database over the trailing ``days``
window. Fail-closed auth, fail-open store: an unreachable analytics
database reports 503 instead of breaking the admin screen.
Return every saved preference set (values only, never queries).

put.description:
Save (or replace) one named preference set.

Bounded to ``MAX_SAVED_PREFS`` entries; beyond that the request
fails with 400 instead of growing the in-process store.

get.description:
Queue view + checkpoint + new-URL list for the dashboard.

Never 500s on state problems: an unreadable snapshot degrades to
the empty status, mirroring the suggest endpoint's degrade rule.

post.description:
Pause crawling and drop every queued URL (admin-only).

Clears the persistent store's ``queued`` rows and purges the Kafka
topic when ``kafka:`` is enabled — the topic must go too, or already
published messages refill the queue on the next resume. In-flight
(``active``) rows are kept, as is all history (``done``/``failed``),
checkpoints, and settings. The in-memory snapshot queue is emptied
so the dashboard stops showing seeds that no longer exist anywhere.
Clearing is best-effort per step and always reports honestly: the
response carries ``cleared_queued`` and ``kafka_purged``.

Pause crawling; the queue snapshot is preserved as-is.

Admin-only (see `_frontier_admin_response`); reads stay open.

Resume crawling, optionally replacing the queue with `seeds`.

Admin-only: seed URLs choose what gets crawled, so untrusted
callers must not set them.

Queue a user-requested URL for admin review (rate-limited).

Dedupes without writing: a URL the frontier already knows returns
a ``duplicate`` marker (200); an existing ``pending`` request is
returned as-is (200). Only genuinely new URLs insert a row (201).

get.description: Admin review queue for user-requested crawl URLs.

post.description: Admin approves a crawl request: marks approved + enqueues the URL.
Admin declines a crawl request (row stays for audit).

get.description:
Current frontier settings (config-seeded, then PUT-overridden).

PUT values persist in the frontier store, so a saved dashboard edit
survives restarts and reaches the crawler workers (which read the
store row, not backend memory). Stored values win over the seeds.

put.description:
Replace the frontier settings (strict body, unknown keys rejected).

Admin-only.

get.description:
List crawler workers recently heard from by this API replica.

Read-only: stays open even when `OPENLENS_FRONTIER_ADMIN_TOKEN` is
set. Only tracks workers heartbeating this replica (see
`frontier_state.WORKER_STALE_AFTER_S`); entries older than the stale
window are pruned on read.

post.description:
Record one worker heartbeat and return the live worker list.

Worker-control plane: admin-only (same gate as pause/resume/settings).
Blank worker ids are
rejected with 422 so anonymous rows can never enter the registry.

get.description:
Effective Kafka reachability for workers (admin-only).

File config seeds the map; a stored PUT overrides it and bumps
``config_version``, which live workers pick up without restarting.

put.description:
Replace the stored cluster map and bump its version (admin-only).

Workers poll the version and recreate their Kafka clients on change,
so broker rotations need no restarts. Other settings keys are
preserved; only the map (plus its new version) is written.

post.description:
Reserve a broker node id and return its join parameters (admin-only).

The operator (or provisioning script) formats the new broker with the
returned cluster id, starts it against the controller quorum, then
marks it joined. Ids are explicit so compose-owned 1-3 are never
reallocated; duplicates are rejected with 409.
Mark a prepared broker joined after verifying it (admin-only).

Build an even-spread replica plan for new brokers (admin-only).

Reads live topic layout (partition count, replication factor unless
overridden) from the broker, so the driver and a reachable broker
are required — otherwise 503. The returned JSON feeds
``kafka-reassign-partitions.sh``; nothing moves until the operator
runs it, so existing brokers are never disturbed by planning.

get.description:
Return one effective config doc plus its winning layer.

Reads stay open (same rule as the frontier reads): a persisted row
wins with ``source: db``; otherwise the YAML-backed file section is
returned with ``source: file``. Unknown doc keys fail with 404.
Live secret values (``api_key`` and friends) are always replaced by
the ``REDACTED_SECRET`` sentinel before leaving the backend.

put.description:
Persist one config doc (strict body, validated like boot).

Admin-only — reuses the exact frontier gate
(`_frontier_admin_response`), no second auth
scheme. The body is validated with the existing startup validators;
anything the boot path would reject fails with 422. The
``REDACTED_SECRET`` sentinel is accepted for secret fields and means
"keep the existing value"; a sentinel with no prior value fails with
422 instead of storing the sentinel as a credential. The write
replaces the row wholesale (version++); the running app's in-memory
config is overlaid so reads stay consistent, and the next boot picks
the row up over the YAML seed. Responses carry the redacted body.

AdminConfigDocResponseSchema.title: AdminConfigDocResponseSchema
AdminConfigDocResponseSchema.description:
GET/PUT /api/v1/admin/config/{doc} response body.

``source`` names the winning layer: ``db`` when a row was written,
``file`` for the YAML-backed fallback. ``version``/``updated_at``
are the row audit fields (version 0 / null when no row exists).

AdminConfigPutSchema.title: AdminConfigPutSchema
AdminConfigPutSchema.description:
PUT /api/v1/admin/config/{doc} body: one config doc section.

The wrapped mapping (or list, for the list-form ``plugins:``
section) is validated by the existing startup validators
(models/providers/ranking/query/plugins); anything the boot path
would reject fails with 422. Extra top-level keys are rejected so no
adjacent sections can be smuggled into a single-doc write.

AnalyticsCountsSchema.title: AnalyticsCountsSchema
AnalyticsCountsSchema.description: Admin analytics overview: durable per-name counts over a window.

ChatCitationSchema.title: ChatCitationSchema
ChatCitationSchema.description: One server-side citation: 1-based ref into the returned hits.

ChatHistoryTurnSchema.title: ChatHistoryTurnSchema
ChatHistoryTurnSchema.description: One prior chat turn (oldest first) sent with a chat request.

ChatTraceSchema.title: ChatTraceSchema
ChatTraceSchema.description: Per-turn chat trace: rewrite, tool searches, fallbacks, call count.

ChatTraceStepSchema.title: ChatTraceStepSchema
ChatTraceStepSchema.description: One step of the chat trace (fixed {kind, detail} shape).

ClusterMapSchema.title: ClusterMapSchema
ClusterMapSchema.description: Live Kafka reachability for workers (strict PUT body).

CrawlRequestListSchema.title: CrawlRequestListSchema
CrawlRequestListSchema.description: Admin review queue for user-requested crawl URLs.

CrawlRequestSchema.title: CrawlRequestSchema
CrawlRequestSchema.description: One stored crawl request; ``duplicate`` is never persisted.

DiagnosticsSchema.title: DiagnosticsSchema
DiagnosticsSchema.description: Per-request diagnostics embedded in the search response.

FeedbackDocSummarySchema.title: FeedbackDocSummarySchema
FeedbackDocSummarySchema.description: Per-document feedback rollup for the admin summary.

FeedbackRequestSchema.title: FeedbackRequestSchema
FeedbackRequestSchema.description:
POST /api/v1/feedback body: anonymous counts with optional reason.

Extra fields are rejected so no query text or identifiers can be
smuggled into the feedback store. `action` must name a canonical
feedback action (see `FEEDBACK_ACTIONS`); common hyphen/space/case
variants are normalized before validation. `reason` is optional and
limited to the closed `FEEDBACK_REASONS` taxonomy ("what was not
right"); it is only accepted with negative/report actions.
(Defined here because schemas.py is owned by wave0; the integrator
may relocate it.)

FeedbackResponseSchema.title: FeedbackResponseSchema
FeedbackResponseSchema.description: Feedback acknowledgement: the triple plus its in-process count.

FeedbackSummarySchema.title: FeedbackSummarySchema
FeedbackSummarySchema.description: Admin feedback overview: totals plus the noisiest documents.

FrontierDiscoverySchema.title: FrontierDiscoverySchema
FrontierDiscoverySchema.description:
A worker's last discovery-pass summary (feeds + refresh).

``at`` is a unix-epoch timestamp for when the worker reported the
summary; ``worker_id`` names the reporting worker (empty on
per-worker entries where the parent already names it).

FrontierNewUrlSchema.title: FrontierNewUrlSchema
FrontierNewUrlSchema.description: One newly discovered URL surfaced by describe_refresh.

FrontierQueueEntrySchema.title: FrontierQueueEntrySchema
FrontierQueueEntrySchema.description: One queued URL in the frontier dashboard view.

FrontierResumeSchema.title: FrontierResumeSchema
FrontierResumeSchema.description:
POST /api/v1/frontier/resume body: optional replacement seeds.

`priority` applies to every seed in the call: higher values dequeue
first (`ORDER BY priority DESC, depth ASC`). Omitted/`None` keeps
whatever the store already has (``0`` for new rows). Negative
values deprioritize below the default.

user_agent.title: User Agent
user_agent.description: Crawler User-Agent applied live by workers; empty/oversize values keep the previous agent.

skip_domains.title: Skip Domains
skip_domains.description: Domain skip-list applied live by workers; entries are bare lowercase hostnames (subdomains match too); malformed entries are ignored, never fatal.

allow_domains.title: Allow Domains
allow_domains.description: Domain allowlist applied live by workers: when non-empty, only these bare lowercase hostnames (subdomains match too) are fetched — the same-domain-only switch. Empty means all domains are allowed. Malformed entries are ignored, never fatal.

deny_domains.title: Deny Domains
deny_domains.description: Domain blocklist applied live by workers; entries are bare lowercase hostnames (subdomains match too); malformed entries are ignored, never fatal.

discovery_feeds.title: Discovery Feeds
discovery_feeds.description: Sitemap/RSS/Atom URLs polled by workers for new articles; empty disables discovery. Malformed entries are ignored, never fatal.

refresh_after_days.title: Refresh After Days
refresh_after_days.description: Requeue done URLs older than this many days for a conditional refetch (0 disables the refresh pass).

discovery_interval_s.title: Discovery Interval S
discovery_interval_s.description: Minimum seconds between worker discovery passes (feeds + refresh). Applies live without restarting workers.

FrontierSettingsSchema.title: FrontierSettingsSchema
FrontierSettingsSchema.description: Frontier crawl settings (strict: unknown keys rejected).

FrontierStatsSchema.title: FrontierStatsSchema
FrontierStatsSchema.description: Cumulative crawler intake counters from one worker heartbeat.

FrontierWorkerSchema.title: FrontierWorkerSchema
FrontierWorkerSchema.description: One crawler worker recently heard from by this API replica.

KafkaNodeSchema.title: KafkaNodeSchema
KafkaNodeSchema.description: One registered Kafka broker node (admin inventory).

PerspectiveStanceSchema.title: PerspectiveStanceSchema
PerspectiveStanceSchema.description: One member's stance toward the story claim (keyword heuristic).

PerspectiveViewSchema.title: PerspectiveViewSchema
PerspectiveViewSchema.description: One story view: claim, member stances, and honesty notes.

ProviderPrefsSchema.title: ProviderPrefsSchema
ProviderPrefsSchema.description: Optional per-query provider preferences on the wire.

RebalanceAssignmentSchema.title: RebalanceAssignmentSchema
RebalanceAssignmentSchema.description: One partition's planned replica set (reassign-partitions shape).

RebalancePlanResponseSchema.title: RebalancePlanResponseSchema
RebalancePlanResponseSchema.description: Even-spread replica plan + the tool command that applies it.

SavedPrefsListResponseSchema.title: SavedPrefsListResponseSchema
SavedPrefsListResponseSchema.description: GET /api/v1/prefs response body: every saved set.

SavedPrefsResponseSchema.title: SavedPrefsResponseSchema
SavedPrefsResponseSchema.description: Acknowledgement for a saved preference set.

SavedPrefsSchema.title: SavedPrefsSchema
SavedPrefsSchema.description:
PUT /api/v1/prefs body: one named preference set.

A saved set is a reusable ``filters`` mapping (preferred domains,
weight overrides, safety preset, category terms) stored under
``name``. Extra fields are rejected so no query text or identifiers
can be smuggled into the store.

SearchResultSchema.title: SearchResultSchema
SearchResultSchema.description: One normalized search hit on the wire.

SuggestResponseSchema.title: SuggestResponseSchema
SuggestResponseSchema.description: GET /api/v1/suggest response body: prefix completions for `q`.
